exact_text: An encoding apparatus, comprising: circuitry configured to:
how_decided: [E01 §3.53] defines an encoder as an embodiment of an encoding process, giving partial contextual support. [E01 §3.54] and [E02 §0.7] explicitly leave encoding algorithms/processes unspecified. [E03 §3.145 NOTE] notes encoder responsibility for bitstream conformance, but H.265 does not mandate dedicated hardware circuitry configured for 1[b]+1[c]. Under the partial-support policy, this is Partial map.
gaps: Mandatory hardware circuitry implementation; specified encoding algorithms configured for combined operations in 1[b] and 1[c].
complete_quote:
[E01 §3.53–3.54 (p.7 / PDF 25)]: 3.53 encoder: An embodiment of an encoding process. 3.54 encoding process: A process not specified in this Specification that produces a bitstream conforming to this Specification.
[E02 §0.7 (p.3 / PDF 21)]: Encoding algorithms (not specified in this Recommendation | International Standard) may select between inter and intra coding for block-shaped regions of each picture.
[E03 §3.145 (p.11 / PDF 29)]: NOTE – When used to express a mandatory constraint on the values of syntax elements or on the results obtained by operation of the specified decoding process, it is the responsibility of the encoder to ensure that the constraint is fulfilled.

exact_text: set a chroma quantization parameter (QP) included in a chroma QP range from 0 to 51 equal to a luma QP range, based on a parameter including a picture level chroma QP offset added to a luma QP; and
how_decided: [E04 §7.4.3.3.1] defines pps_cb_qp_offset/pps_cr_qp_offset (-12..+12). [E05 §8.6.1] Eq. (8-285)/(8-286) add PPS chroma offsets to QpY and map qPi (clipped to 57) into QpC 0–51 (via Table 8-10 where 57−6=51 for 4:2:0, or Min(qPi,51) otherwise). [E06 §7.4.3.2.1] Eq. (7-7) yields QpBdOffsetC=0 at 8-bit depth. Partial map (not Full) because Clause 8 specifies conditional decoding derivation rather than mandatory encoder circuitry.
gaps: Mandatory encoder-side derivation (Clause 8 specifies decoding process); unconditional 0–51 range across >8-bit depths (QpBdOffsetC > 0) and ACT modes.
complete_quote:
[E04 §7.4.3.3.1 (p.83 / PDF 101)]: pps_cb_qp_offset and pps_cr_qp_offset specify the offsets to the luma quantization parameter Qp′Y used for deriving Qp′Cb and Qp′Cr, respectively. The values of pps_cb_qp_offset and pps_cr_qp_offset shall be in the range of −12 to +12, inclusive.
[E05 §8.6.1 (p.176 / PDF 194)]: qPiCb = Clip3( −QpBdOffsetC, 57, QpY + pps_cb_qp_offset + slice_cb_qp_offset + CuQpOffsetCb ) (8-285) ... If ChromaArrayType is equal to 1, qPCb and qPCr are set equal to QpC in Table 8-10 (where qPi > 43 -> QpC = qPi − 6, so 57 -> 51); otherwise Min(qPi, 51).
[E06 §7.4.3.2.1 (p.76 / PDF 94)]: QpBdOffsetC = 6 * bit_depth_chroma_minus8 (7-7).

exact_text: quantize transform data that is orthogonal-transformed from a picture, based on the set chroma QP to generate quantized data.
how_decided: [E07 §0.7] confirms prediction residual is compressed using a transform before quantization, providing genuine partial functional support in permissive introductory text. [E08 §8.6.2] Eq. (8-292)/(8-293) show chroma QPs (Qp′Cb, Qp′Cr) governing transform coefficient scaling (qP = Qp′Cb / Qp′Cr). Partial map because forward encoder quantization circuitry and explicit orthogonal transform mandates are not specified.
gaps: Explicit orthogonal transform specification in normative text; mandatory forward encoder quantization step using the exact QP set in 1[b].
